annotation.title_clean: Commission Decision of 7 March 2013 on the safety requirements to be met by European standards for certain seats for children pursuant to Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety (2013/121/EU)
annotation.title_en: Commission Decision of 7 March 2013 on the safety requirements to be met by European standards for certain seats for children pursuant to Directive 2001/95/EC on general product safety (2013/121/EU)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 65/23
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Decision setting safety requirements that European standards must meet for children's chairs, high chairs, chair-mounted seats and table-mounted chairs under the General Product Safety Directive 2001/95/EC. Covers entrapment, stability, restraints, choking, labelling and instructions. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines chair-mounted seats, children's chairs, high chairs and table-mounted chairs.
Annex sets safety requirements European standards must meet under Directive 2001/95/EC.
Requires restraint systems, stability, and prevention of entrapment, choking and suffocation hazards.
Mandates warnings, user manuals and manufacturer/importer identification.
Enters into force twentieth day after publication in the OJ.
